result.summary: The image shows a residential urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the environment lacks traffic signals and has parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left sides of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides of a residential street. Safety is supported by basic infrastructure like curb ramps, but is compromised by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the intersection.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near crosswalk
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection obstruct the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking in the sightline of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the crosswalk to improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a marked zebra crosswalk but lacks traffic control devices like stop signs or signals. While sidewalks are present on both sides, there are no visible curb ramps, and parked vehicles near the intersection may obstruct sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No sloped transition from the sidewalk to the street at the crosswalk, creating a barrier for mobility-impaired users.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars are situated very close to the crosswalk, blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street near the crossing

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any accompanying stop signs or signals to regulate traffic and prioritize pedestrian movement.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image at the intersection

interventions.title: Install ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Add sloped ramps at the crosswalk to ensure accessibility for all users, including those with strollers or wheelchairs.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Add Stop Signs
interventions.description: Convert the intersection to an all-way stop to slow traffic and provide clear right-of-way for pedestrians.

result.summary: The street features a marked zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks, but lacks active traffic control or signage. Parked vehicles near the intersection create significant visual obstructions, reducing the safety of the crossing for pedestrians.

hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk block the line of sight between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: There are no stop signs or traffic signals to regulate vehicle flow at this marked pedestrian crossing.
